# Legacy Life Builder

An AI weekly planner and goal tracker. It turns big goals into daily tasks, time-blocks the week, tracks habits, and resets the plan in one tap when life changes.

## What it does

- Goal breakdown: AI splits a goal into years, months, weeks and daily tasks and places the work in the week.
- Time blocking: goals, habits and tasks sit in 30-minute slots. Overlaps are prevented.
- Weekly reset: when the user falls behind, Reset compares planned time with available time and suggests what to keep, move, reduce or remove. Nothing changes until the user approves it, and removed work is saved, not deleted.
- Habits and routines: set once, they appear in the planner every week.
- Priorities: weekly and daily outcomes keep the focus on what matters.
- Life balance: work is tagged to income, assets, recovery and relationships.
- Insights: consistency, execution and milestone tracking.
